# RxFiles

> Evidence-based pharmaceutical resource providing drug comparison charts, landmark clinical trial summaries, and therapeutic guides for healthcare professionals.

RxFiles is an initiative of the University of Saskatchewan that synthesizes clinical trial data and medication comparisons to support informed prescribing decisions. The platform offers subscription-based access to curated drug therapy comparisons and landmark trial analyses across multiple therapeutic areas including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, nephrology, and neurology.

## Key Topics

- Drug Comparison Charts
- Landmark Clinical Trials
- Alzheimer's Disease
- Chronic Kidney Disease
- Diabetes
- Heart Failure
- COPD
- Lecanemab
- Finerenone
- Empagliflozin
- Medication Reference
- Pharmaceutical Guide
- University of Saskatchewan
- Evidence-Based Prescribing
- Therapeutic Comparisons
